text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Use shared decision-making to select integrated evidence-based treatment for alcohol use disorder and PTSD
  • Offer behavioral AUD treatment and discuss FDA-approved medication options; patient initially selects behavioral treatment
  • Begin trauma-focused psychotherapy without requiring recovery to be perfect or linear
  • Repeat AUDIT-C, PCL-5, and PHQ-9 at six and twelve weeks and maintain a collaborative relapse and safety plan
